correctness.rationale: Li–Yuan Theorem 3.4 proves min_{1<=j<=k}Q_j=o(1/k) where Q_j=Σ_i(c_i+tilde c_i)||x_i^{j+1}-x_i^j||²>=0. Taking square roots yields only min sqrt(Q_j)=o(k^(-1/2)). For z_j=1/log(j+2), MVT gives |Δz_j|~1/[j(log j)^2] so Σ(Δz_j)²<∞ and min_{j<=k}(Δz_j)²=o(1/k), but for EVERY subsequence j_l→∞, j_l z_{j_l}→∞. Therefore the square-increment estimate does not imply ANY o(1/k) iterate-to-limit subsequence rate. Verified Li–Yuan original Theorem 3.4 and its narrative distinction; counterexample is a logical countermodel, expressly NOT claimed as a proximal ADMM iterate trajectory.
